items.hed: Rockets host Minnesota tonight at Toyota Center, 8:30 p.m. ET
items.insight: NBA.com lists the game for Wednesday, Nov. 4, at 8:30 p.m. ET, which is 7:30 p.m. in Houston. The page also notes Houston held Boston to 38.6 percent shooting in Monday's 109-93 win. Tipoff has not arrived, so there is no final to print.

items.hed: Texans play the Chargers Sunday at SoFi Stadium
items.insight: The club's transactions page still shows Monday's moves: signed defensive tackle Naquan Jones, released running back Deuce Vaughn, waived defensive tackle Jaden Crumedy, and added running back Joshua Pitsenberger to the practice squad. Houston's news page points to Sunday, Nov. 8, at SoFi Stadium, for the ways to watch the Chargers game.

items.hed: Astros' Monday roster moves stand: Correa activated, Reifert acquired
items.insight: MLB's transaction log shows no Houston moves dated Nov. 3 or Nov. 4. Monday's log still has Carlos Correa, Mike Burrows, and Brandon Walter activated from the 60-day injured list, Evan Reifert acquired from Tampa Bay for cash, Roddery Muñoz and César Salazar selected from Sugar Land, and Jake Meyers sent outright to Sugar Land.
